source.author: verg
source.text: Idem omnes simul ardor habet, rapiuntque ruuntque; litora deseruere; latet sub classibus aequor; adnixi torquent spumas et caerula verrunt.
source.text_original: Idem omnes simul ardor habet, rapiuntque ruuntque; / litora deseruere; latet sub classibus aequor; / adnixi torquent spumas et caerula verrunt.
source.text_english: The same eagerness holds them all together, and they snatch and rush; they have deserted the shores; the sea lies hidden beneath the fleets; straining at the oars, they churn up foam and sweep the blue waters.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: olim annis ille ardor hebet, necdum mea proles imperio et belli rebus matura marique.
reuse.text_original: olim annis ille ardor hebet, necdum mea proles / imperio et belli rebus matura marique.
reuse.text_english: Long ago that fire has grown dull with the years, and my offspring is not yet ripe for command and for the affairs of war and the sea.
